name: skills
description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
one_liner: An official pack of ready-made instructions that teach AI coding agents how to correctly use Google's own products and developer tools.
buyer: A developer or small company building on Google Cloud or Firebase who wants their AI assistant to get Google-specific APIs right instead of hallucinating.
business_use_cases: A startup building on Firebase uses it so their AI coding agent writes correct security rules and API calls the first time.
A consulting shop that builds client apps on Google Cloud bakes it into every project template to cut debugging time on Google API integrations.
A training company builds a 'Google Cloud plus AI agents' workshop using these skills as the curriculum backbone.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell premium add-on skill packs for specific Google product combinations not covered by the official set, targeted at consultancies.

steal_this: This weekend, build a short paid guide or workshop for one specific Google product integration using this skill pack as the technical backbone.
